library.title: Library
library.pick_title: Choose the folder where you keep your manga
library.pick_body: Each folder inside becomes a collection, and its PDF, CBR and CBZ files are the volumes. Hakufu only reads it: it never copies, moves or deletes anything.
library.empty_body: Create a folder for each series inside your library folder, put your PDF, CBR or CBZ volumes in it and click “Refresh”.
library.empty_body_ios: Open the Files app, go to “On My iPhone/iPad → Hakufu”, create a folder for each series and put your PDF, CBR or CBZ volumes in it. Then come back and tap “Refresh”.
library.scan_no_root: Choose the folder where you keep your manga.
library.scan_unreadable: Can't read the folder “{0}”. Is the drive connected, or has it moved?
